callees.name: _extracted_file_to_source_rel
callees.pre_condition: extracted_rel is a string formed by joining the '::'-separated components of a valid FQN with the platform's path separator, producing a relative path that corresponds to an extracted function file path beneath the extracted_functions/ directory tree.
callees.post_condition: Returns the project-relative path (using platform-native path separators) of the original source file from which the function at the path represented by extracted_rel was extracted. The mapping respects the <base>-<ext> directory convention, such that multiple function paths extracted from the same source file (including class-qualified member functions from the same module) resolve to the same returned path.
